canonicalization: Prefer the sole exact repository gene with the same expanded topology. Otherwise choose the lexicographically smallest decoded 28-value gene that reproduces the serialized three-branch Keras topology. Duplicate channel, kernel, and repeat aliases use indices 0-3; identity uses [7, 0, 0].
scientific_note: Canonical-equivalent genes reproduce the serialized architecture exactly, but must not be represented as the unavailable original genotype.
